name: OBXENE
description: OBXENE returns with Max Durante, Unhuman, Jeffrey, Alhena and more. A night of hard techno, trance and industrial sounds in one of Berlin's most committed underground spaces. Known for pushing sonic boundaries and fostering a non-commercial club ethos, OBXENE represents a new generation of promoters reshaping Berlin's nocturnal landscape with uncompromising bookings and immersive atmospheres.
